newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat European car sales rise 15 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Fiat European car sales rise 15 pct in May.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat Auto saw European car sales rise 15 percent in May in an overall European car market that slipped 0.5 percent, an auto sector source said.
The group's European market share rose to 12.9 percent in May from 11.1 percent in May 1996, maintaining its second place in the European market after Germany's Volkswagen.
In the first five months of this year, Fiat Auto sales rose 7.0 percent in a European market that rose by just 0.6 percent, giving it a market share for the January-May period of 12.6 percent.
